usedFor: Raisely collects fundraising gifts, and each “New Online Donation” opens a task in Pyrus.

bestTemplate.name: “New Online Donation” in Raisely, then “Create Task With Form” in Pyrus
bestTemplate.why: Every card or PayPal donation becomes a Pyrus task, so a thank-you or receipt step has an owner.

watchOut: “Create Task With Form” in Pyrus needs an existing form, so build that form before the template.
